author: LorSyon
body:
Hi guys I just finished building my first map
And Thanks to all the feedback from people.
And a big thanks to Strafes who helped me with the YML.

Dursia:

~ 3 monuments
~ Iron blocks on the top of spawn
~ 2 diamond block's on  each small islands with 5 diamond ores around them.
~ 12 gold blocks
~ 2 knockback II diamond shovels
~ 3 flame bows   
~ 9 separate islands

Teams:

Red team:
Raiders

Orange team:
Warriors

YML:
http://pastebin.com/WA5aHiVC

Download:
http://www.mediafire.com/download/8fvqii8p47k5ori/Empty_World_-_Copy.rar

Big thanks to my friend youtube for helping me with the download.
And sorry that its named emptyworld - copy xD

Photos:

http://imgur.com/a/KgdKD#3

replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
Looks so good, but I have some issues I see :/
I see the aesthetics look good, however i'm not sure the gameplay will be good. The map is really small, imagine 25v25 game or 20v20 game in the map. It will all be mostly in the middle islands, and will be not much gameplay going on, I may be wrong but that's my opinion D:
But the aesthetics are still godly, so as for now, +0.5, i'm sure you can improve the map :) Don't give up!

I found some errors in the YML, will be happy if you'll fix it :D

Line 9 should be 32.5, not 32.4
DTM maps don't need duration (at least what I have been told)
The title should be only Dursia and the type is dtm, no need Dursia DTM
Delete the spaces in each monument location, for example 3,4,5 and not 3, 4, 5.
